answer: The pulse index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 687 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the prism. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the forge queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The bill scales 19 fold, not the vote. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
